messages.subject: font size distribution letters
parts:
Hi Nick,

I have a quick question regarding tree graphics in BiogeoBEARS. My phylogeny contains 150 taxa and the R script is running smoothly. But the thing is that the colored boxes with the distribution information are way too big since there are so many tips in my tree. If I change the size (statecex/splitcex) in the plot command, the boxes get a suitable size, but the letters within these boxes are getting disproportionately small. Can I change the font size of the distribution letters separately?

Thank you very much and many regards from Germany (perhaps you remember me from the youth hostel breakfast table in Bayreuth!! ;)

Kristina

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] font size distribution letters
parts:
Hi -- there isn't much to suggest beyond fiddling with it, but the thing that might help the most is changing the height and width in the pdf() command.  The default is height=11 or 6 something, which works for a small tree, but for a large tree you may get better results with 22 or 33 etc.

The box size and letter size both come from the APE nodelabels() command, which the BioGeoBEARS plot function is using, so that's the other thing to check -- you are free to hack the BioGeoBEARS plot function of course, it's just a wrapper for the standard APE plot.phylo, nodelabels(), tiplabels() etc. commands.

Cheers!
Nick
